notes.title: Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow zombie killers,

We at [b]AppRoarr Studios [/b]are happy to announce an update patch for the game with numerous bug fixes and performance enhancements. 

We've introduced a DEMO for those who want to try out the game first.

[b]New Updates:[/b]
- Improved lighting
- Movement tweaks
- AI improvements (Game is tougher than ever XD)
- Audio enhancements (OST coming soon)
- Minor tweaks and bug fixes


Thank you all for playing the game and if there are any issues or bugs you would like to report, please get in touch with us-

Email: hello@approarr.com

Stay awesome!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32553826/1a77d0d05b1b77e5b8ca45b3447057c08e714e14.png[/img]


{[b]P.S[/b]. We apologize for not updating the game as regularly - we were busy making some big improvements.}

notes.title: Controller Support Added! [Patch 2892508]
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,

We are pleased to announce that with the lastest patch update, you can now play Kill 'em All with a controller.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32553826/e6027030462a76d87848bcd56b18f3943126e67a.png[/img]


You can find the controls mapping in the in-game menu (Controls).

As always thank you all for playing the game and if there are any issues or bugs you would like to report, please get in touch with us-

Email: hello@approarr.com

Stay awesome!

notes.title: Local Translations Not Perfect
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!

We are aware that the in-game translations aren't perfect as we'd like them to be and we are working towards making all the required updates at the earliest. 

Being a small indie studio it gets a bit tough to arrange for translation resources, but we are reaching out to our fellow gamers, developers and community members, requesting them to help us out with the translations. We’ll be pushing out regular updates for this in the coming weeks.

Thank you for playing Kill ‘Em All and for the support. You all are AWESOME!


[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32553826/d2082bfbe5c5ed84d9f4ef9290a6d13143dda7d7.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32553826/1a77d0d05b1b77e5b8ca45b3447057c08e714e14.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Kill 'Em All - Patch v2829825
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,

Thank you for playing Kill 'Em All. The new Patch is live and below is the log.

[h1]Patch Log :[/h1]

[b]Fixed an issue due to which the Arcade was broken. [/b]
[i]Possible reason: The script conversion due to a different backend used by the game engine. While testing, the bug didn't crop up, but in the release build it came due to some compilation errors. Now it is fixed as we have changed the scripting backend.[/i]


As always thank you all for playing the game and if there are any issues or bugs you would like to report, please get in touch with us-

Email: hello@approarr.com

Thank you!
